reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact 65x67 source PNG, enlarged existing source-page 08, complete unchanged 2048x2048 raw RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha review sheet and unchanged naiwa.png; checked cap, covered hair and temple edge, brows, absence of facial hair and glasses, one mouth, uniform details, pose, crop, lighting, collar fit, complete card/note/backplate and visible transparency.

entries.positive_observation: The dark olive peaked cap with gold wreath-like front insignia, gold crown piping and dark visor remains, with short dark-brown temple hair and dark eyebrows; no extended sideburn, moustache, beard or spectacles was added. The face has a smooth chin and one serious closed mouth. The nearly frontal capped head tilted subtly toward viewer left, forward-to-slightly-left gaze, chest-up crop and strong asymmetric visor shadow are retained. The dark olive uniform keeps two red-and-gold collar patches, a small pale-gray throat opening and gold shoulder trim at viewer left. The high collar fits a short broad neck beneath the rounded chin with coherent cloth contact and no long yellow column, pinching, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque muted gray-olive photographic backplate, overlapping warm-cream note with compact upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small dark right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan inspection shows a genuine transparent exterior without visible holes, lost backing or working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema 0..254 after actual white/cyan/alpha viewing; no source-alpha replacement was performed or needed, and values 252-254 alone were not treated as defects.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact cap and collar details and the finest temple-hair edge cannot be resolved at 65x67; only visible source-scale shapes and placements were compared, without claiming exact symbols or hidden hair. Note marks remain indistinct rather than readable text.
